title: Files and programs
description: The brick's file system, file content in chunks, programs and shell commands. A write or a deployment to a path whose folders do not exist yet creates them.

kilobytes.description: Kilobytes, rounded up, as the firmware reports them.

files.description: Files the total covers; zero for a plain file.

RemoveReport.description: What a recursive removal could not delete.

TransferProgress.description: What a file request reports through $/progress, with the token the request carried.

DeployFile.description: One file of a deployment: from a local path the daemon reads, or small inline content.

content.description: Base64, at most 4 KiB once decoded.

skipIfSameMd5.description: Skip the upload when the brick already holds a file with the same MD5.

StartOutcome.description: How a start ended. started: the brick reported the program running. not_seen_running: the start was confirmed but the program was not seen running; it may have ended at once. uncertain: the reply to the start was lost; do not start again, read the program's state first.

runSeq.description: This start's number on the brick: the daemon counts every start it is asked for per brick, a refused one included, so numbers may skip. The count is kept in the daemon's state directory, so a daemon that replaces another counts on. A state with a lower runSeq is about an earlier run; with replace, the old program's end may still arrive under the new number.

skipped.description: Files skipped because the brick held the same content.

runSeq.description: The number of the last start sent to this brick, by this daemon or one it replaced (0 before any).

stoppedBy.description: The client that stopped it, when a stop ended it.
